title: Claude Fable 5.5 reportedly spotted in Azure configs, but Anthropic has not confirmed it
key_facts: A model called Claude Fable 5.5 has reportedly turned up in Microsoft Azure configuration files, according to a post circulating on X; the post suggests a release may be near.
As of 13 Oct 2026 Anthropic has made no announcement of a Fable 5.5 and Microsoft has confirmed nothing.
The sighting is unverified; no screenshots or documentation from either company confirm the model exists.
Anthropic's documentation lists Claude Fable 5.1, released on 1 Sep 2026, as the most advanced Fable model.
Fable 5 launched on 9 Jun 2026 with a 1 million token context window, at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, on Azure, AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud.
Opus 5.5 launched on 22 Sep 2026 and Sonnet 5.5 followed shortly after; Anthropic's 5.5 release notes stop at those two.
Crypto Briefing says the Fable 5.5 name appears to come from pattern-matching rather than from any Anthropic statement.
Signals that would settle it: an update to Anthropic's model documentation, an Anthropic announcement, or a listing from Microsoft, AWS or Google Cloud.
